title: At five life, every creature stays home to block
briefing: Held out for ADR 0043 (written after the fixes were tuned, never tuned against): price next turn's swing before attacking. P1 is at 5 with Leatherback Baloth, Grizzly Bears and Llanowar Elves. P3 and P4 have no blockers, so any attack connects. P2 untaps next with Kalonian Tusker, Grizzly Bears and Savannah Lions: 7 power against 5 life, and P1's three creatures can block all three. Each attacker sent leaves one P2 creature unblocked.

reference.analysis: P2's next swing is 3 + 2 + 2 = 7 against 5 life. With all three creatures home P1 blocks everything and takes nothing. One attacker away leaves a 2-power creature unblocked (P1 to 3) for a few points on a player nowhere near dead; two away lets at least 4 through, and all three away is lethal.

options.label: No attack
options.why: Every P2 attacker can be blocked next turn.

options.label: Only the Elves attack
options.why: One damage dealt for two taken next turn.

options.label: Only the Bears attack
options.why: Two damage dealt, two taken next turn, at 5 life.

options.label: Only the Baloth attacks
options.why: Four damage dealt, and P1 drops to 3 next turn behind its two smallest blockers.

otherwise.why: Two or more attackers leave at most one blocker against three attackers: P1 drops to 1 or dies.
